{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
completed_no_qa = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_no_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the required numbers explicitly
num_completed_no_qa = len(completed_no_qa)
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA: {num_completed_no_qa}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
